investigation.title: Teen who didn't come home – public street at night
investigation.context: Sam's family reports a photo from 3 hours ago on a public city street, around 12°C at night. They are checking nearby crossings, open businesses and transit stops.
investigation.summary: A lit public intersection has a broad crosswalk, traffic signals, a 30th St sign and a 24-hour restaurant. These clues form the prepared location comparison.

candidates.rationale: The 30th St sign, broad crossing and late-night restaurant frontage support this first prepared comparison.
A nearby public commercial corridor offers a similar crossing layout but a weaker frontage match.
A broad lit intersection in the same general area, with a weaker street-sign match.

clues.label: Crosswalk
clues.observation: A broad striped public crossing spans the street.
clues.significance: Start with major public intersections rather than private homes.

clues.label: Traffic signals
clues.observation: Several overhead traffic lights control the intersection.
clues.significance: The signal layout narrows the prepared street comparison.

clues.label: Street sign
clues.observation: A 30th St sign is visible above the intersection.
clues.significance: This is the most specific visible text clue.

clues.label: Restaurant
clues.observation: An illuminated restaurant sign says open 24 hours.
clues.significance: An open public business could provide a nearby contact point.

clues.label: Lighting
clues.observation: Streetlights and illuminated signs stand out against a dark sky.
clues.significance: The family also reports nighttime conditions.

analysis.verified: Prepared example, not a live verification
